anil_devex: Weird one today: async client + streaming request body (generator) + transient 502 -> on replay the body is empty and backend created a default resource, so we got a duplicate with no fields set.

zoe_sdk: hmm that sounds like the body iterator was consumed on first attempt and not replayable. Which API call? files, data, or json?

anil_devex: multipart upload using files= with an async generator. Minimal repro below. Repro in CI with fake upstream that returns 502 then 201.

anil_devex: ```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def file_gen():
    for i in range(3):
        yield b"chunk-%d\n" % i
        await asyncio.sleep(0)

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(api_key="sk-test-xxx", timeout=3.0)
    # streaming file, non-replayable by design currently
    resp = await c.post("/v1/uploads", files={"file": ("f.txt", file_gen())}, headers={"Idempotency-Key":"stream-1"})
    print(resp.status, await resp.text())

asyncio.run(main())
```

matt_infra: paste transport logs? curious whether retry path tried to re-open generator or accidentally sent an empty body.

anil_devex: logs: 

```
-> POST /v1/uploads
-> Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxx
-> Body: streaming (generator)
<- 502 Bad Gateway
Retrying (attempt 2)...
-> POST /v1/uploads
-> Headers: Idempotency-Key: stream-1
-> Body: (empty)
<- 201 Created
```

anil_devex: Because body empty on replay backend inserted blank metadata and returned 201. Customer hit this during an import.

zoe_sdk: ok this is a different class of replay bug than auth-on-retry. Current behavior: for streaming bodies we mark request as non-replayable and should not retry. Looks like we attempted a retry anyway (bug). Root causes to investigate: 1) our retry decider didn't mark stream-consumed as non-retriable after cancel; 2) we attempt replay using saved headers but body is gone and we still retry.

hana_pm: customer impact? severity? any mitigation for users now?

anil_devex: customer saw a bad import with some empty items. Severity P1 for the pilot. Mitigation: re-run import with idempotency keys per file chunk OR disable retries via client(retry_policy="none") until patched. Both are awful UX.

zoe_sdk: plan: 1) fix retry decider so requests with non-replayable streaming bodies are not retried (even on transient 5xx/timeouts) unless user opts into buffering; 2) add optional buffering switch buffer_streams=True with size cap and clear docs + explicit warning in API; 3) add high-level helper upload_file(path, idempotency_key=None) that opens the file in a replay-friendly way and sets Idempotency-Key automatically; 4) add unit/integration tests that simulate 502+stream and assert no-spurious-retry.

matt_infra: also need to ensure status codes that are safe to retry don't cause destructive behavior when body missing. We should log and surface a clear error when a non-replayable request would be retried.

zoe_sdk: filed GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/3010 "streamed body replay: prevent empty-body retry + upload helper + buffer option" and opened a draft PR fix/stream-replay-3010.

ci-bot: Branch fix/stream-replay-3010 created. CI will run integration repro job.

hana_pm: thanks. can we add an SDK changelog note and docs example for upload_file helper so customers migrate?

zoe_sdk: yes. I'll add docs, upgrade notes, and an explicit error message for attempts to retry non-replayable streams. Also adding convenience idempotency_key param to upload helpers.

anil_devex: added the tiny repro and curl traces to #3010. thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
